definitions.explanation: Money coming into an account or being deposited.

examples.japanese: {入金|にゅうきん}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{給料|きゅうりょう}の{入金|にゅうきん}があった。
{入金|にゅうきん}{日|び}は{毎月|まいつき}25{日|にち}です。
examples.english: The payment date is the 25th of every month.

notes:
{入金|にゅうきん} refers to money being deposited or received.

CONTRAST:
- {入金|にゅうきん}: money coming in
- {出金|しゅっきん}: money going out (withdrawal)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}{確認|かくにん}: deposit confirmation
- {入金|にゅうきん}{日|び}: payment/deposit date
- {入金|にゅうきん}{通知|つうち}: deposit notification
